title: Split one closed standalone part into separate configuration files

params.name: masters
params.description: Exactly one closed standalone master per candidate invocation. The previous standalone utility supports several masters. The recipe preserves the master.

params.name: outputFolder
params.description: Each master's files go in a subfolder here named after the master.

params.name: nameFormat
params.description: File name for each output, without extension. {config} is the configuration name, {name} the master's file name.
